resources.string: Updates in the background are best-effort and their timing is decided by the operating system.
When off, Trenify delivers no notifications. Monitored trains keep refreshing on a best-effort basis.
System notifications are disabled, so Trenify cannot deliver notifications. Monitoring stays active.
Notifies when the delay reaches this threshold or moves past another multiple of it, including recovery to a lower value. Applies to newly monitored trains.
Enter a positive number of minutes.
Choose which monitored-train events send a notification to this device.
Get notified about strikes that may affect monitored trains. Uses the same preference as Alerts.
Notifications are disabled. Monitoring remains active while Trenify can refresh.
Removes all journey searches, train searches and recent-station suggestions from this device. Favorites, monitored trains, settings and saved stations are kept.
Delete all search history? Journey searches, train searches and recent stations will be removed. This cannot be undone.
Removes all favorite stations, routes and trains from this device. Search history, monitored trains, settings and saved stations are kept.
Delete all favorites? Favorite stations, routes and trains will be removed. This cannot be undone.
Deletion failed. Nothing was partially deleted; you can retry.
